intro: A Rogue's Deal is a confrontation with Calvin Montague in Deathknell. After offering work to newly awakened Forsaken with the promise of wealth, the sly rogue's true intentions come to light when payment is demanded.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You want money? I don't owe you any money.
Letter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? All right, mate... Let's do this! Owe you any money…

clips.title: Progress
paras: Not bad, mate... Not bad at all.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thought you'd be easy prey, friend. Got me good, you did.
Here's the coin I promised... Not as much as I said it'd be, but that's on a count o' me lying to ya in the first place.
